Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Sent: Wednesday, August 22, 2018 9:54 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Schedule story 
 
Anthony: We’ve got to be cleaner, man.

We wrote they had a six-game west coast trip … it’s seven. Talked about interleague play, had them playing the Marlins for two games. It’s three. Mentioned every interleague series, omitted they host the Phillies.
